NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's web site under City Council Meeting agendas at www.RollingHillsEstatesCA.gov
  and during regular business hours in the office of the City Clerk. Meetings are live broadcast on the City's
  web site and a recording is available for viewing after each meeting. Meetings are also broadcast on
  PVP-TV Channel 35 (Cox) and Channel 39 (Verizon).

  Public Comment is welcome on any item during City Council consideration of the item. An opportunity is
  also provided for the public to comment on non-agenda items concerning City matters. If you would like to
  address the City Council regarding an item on this agenda or make a general public comment, please
  complete a speaker sheet and give to the City Clerk.

MINUTES
  ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  JULY 8, 2019

An adjourned meeting of the City Council of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order
by MAYOR MITCHELL at 8:09 a.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Mayor Mitchell led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Mitchell, Zuckerman
City Council Members Absent:  Schmitz, Zerunyan

City Staff Present: City Manager Doug Prichard
  Assistant City Manager Greg Grammer
  Planning Director David Wahba
  Assistant to the City Manager Alexa Davis
  City Clerk Heidi Luce

PUBLIC COMMENT / PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS

NONE.

NEW BUSINESS

A.  BID RESULTS FOR FY 2019-20 *REVISED* PALOS VERDES DRIVE NORTH STREET
  RESURFACING PROJECT

  Recommendation: That the City Council: 1) Accept the bid from Hardy & Harper, Inc. in
  the total amount of $474,620.35 for the Palos Verdes Drive North Resurfacing Project,
  plus a 10% contingency for a grand total of $522,082.39; and 2) Approve the Public Works
  Contract between the City of Rolling Hills Estates and Hardy & Harper, Inc., all to the
  satisfaction of the City Attorney.

  Planning Director Wahba provided a staff report (as per the agenda material).

  In response to COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF regarding re-paving the portion of Palos
  Verdes Drive North from Palos Verdes Drive East to the eastern City limit, Planning
  Director Wahba explained that it is not part of this project and will be paved in the coming
  years as part of a future project.

  In response to COUNCIL MEMBER ZUCKERMAN regarding Hardy & Harper’s
  references, Assistant City Manager Grammer stated that they have done work in Rancho

ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  1
JULY 8, 2019
   Palos Verdes. He further noted that they have also done work in Rolling Hills Estates
  previously.

  In response to MAYOR MITCHELL, Planning Director Wahba confirmed that Cal Water
  will pave large sections of the plated areas on the eastbound portion of Palos Verdes
  Drive North in the area of their construction project once the project is complete.

  COUNCILMEMBER ZUCKERMAN moved, seconded by, COUNCILMEMBER HUFF

  THAT THE CITY COUNCIL ACCEPT THE BID FROM HARDY & HARPER, INC.
  IN THE AMOUNT OF $474,620.35 FOR THE PALOS VERDES DRIVE NORTH
  RESURFACING PROJECT, PLUS A 10% CONTINGENCY FOR A GRAND
  TOTAL OF $522,082.39; AND APPROVE THE PUBLIC WORKS CONTRACT
  BETWEEN THE CITY OF ROLLING HILLS ESTATES AND HARDY & HARPER,
  INC. ALL TO THE SATISFACTION OF THE CITY ATTORNEY.

  AYES:  Huff, Mitchell, Zuckerman
  ABSENT:  Schmitz, Zerunyan

B.  PALOS VERDES DRIVE EAST BRIDLE TRAIL STORM DRAIN REPAIRS – CONTRACT
  WITH E.C. CONSTRUCTION COMPANY

  Recommendation: That the City Council 1) Accept the bid proposal from E.C.
  Construction, in the total of $43,600 for the Palos Verdes Drive East storm drain repair
  project, plus a $20,000 contingency for a grand total of $63,600; and 2) Approve the
  Public Works contract between the City of Rolling Hills Estates and E.C. Construction, all
  to the satisfaction of the City Attorney.

  Planning Director Wahba provided a staff report (as per the agenda material).

  Brief discussion ensued concerning the storm drain related issues on Palos Verdes Drive
  East and at Rolling Hills Country Club.

  COUNCIL MEMBER ZUCKERMAN moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF

  THAT THE CITY COUNCIL ACCEPT THE BID PROPOSAL FROM E.C.
  CONSTRUCTION IN THE AMOUNT OF $43,600 FOR THE PALOS VERDES
  DRIVE EAST STORM DRAIN REPAIR PROJECT, PLUS A $20,000
  CONTINGENCY FOR A GRAND TOTAL OF $63,600; AND APPROVE THE
  PUBLIC WORKS CONTRACT BETWEEN THE CITY OF ROLLING HILLS
  ESTATES AND E.C. CONSTRUCTION, ALL TO THE SATISFACTION OF THE
  CITY ATTORNEY.

  AYES:  Huff, Mitchell, Zuckerman
  ABSENT:  Schmitz, Zerunyan

ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  2
JULY 8, 2019
 ADJOURNMENT

Recognizing that this was City Manager Prichard’s last City Council meeting, MAYOR
MITCHELL thanked him for his service to the City and wished him well in his retirement.

At 8:44 a.m. MAYOR MITCHELL adjourned the City Council meeting to the next regular meeting
of the Rolling Hills Estates City Council scheduled to be held on Tuesday, July 23, 2019
beginning at 7:00 p.m. in the Council Chamber at Rolling Hills Estates City Hall, 4045 Palos
Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Heidi Luce  Greg Grammer
City Clerk  City Manager

ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  3
JULY 8, 2019
